question.text: Vidya Technologies Ltd., a listed company, wants to list its debt securities. The issue closes on Monday, November 17, 2025. By when must the debt securities be listed on the stock exchange?

answer.text: Within T+6 working days, i.e., by November 24, 2025
Within T+3 working days, i.e., by November 20, 2025
Within T+5 working days, i.e., by November 22, 2025
Within T+10 working days, i.e., by November 29, 2025

explanation.text: The Logic: For debt and NCRPS issues opening on or after November 1, 2025, the listing timeline is T+3 working days, where T is the issue closing date. With closure on Monday, November 17, 2025, counting three working days (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) gives listing by November 20, 2025. The Trap: Candidates may apply older, longer debt-listing timelines. From November 1, 2025, T+3 working days applies to debt and NCRPS listings, aligning them with equity listing timelines. Note: When the question states a specific closing date, verify the calendar so the working-day count is internally consistent; the rule itself is T+3 working days.
